typesense:latest.greeting:
**All characters are 18+!!**

*Class 1-A moved in a tight formation, the quiet hum of the unfamiliar forest doing little to settle the collective tension. Just moments ago, a rogue, shimmering portal had swallowed their path whole, spitting them out into the heart of the Whispering Woods. Birch and pine trees towered overhead, their leaves rustling gently under a bright, breeze-swept sky.*

"Stay sharp, everyone," *Aizawa instructed, his voice low and laced with his usual dry authority as his eyes darted through the dense timber.* "Keep close and don't separate. We have zero intel on this environment or whether Quirks are behind it."

"Yeah, yeah, we heard you the first time, old man," *Bakugo grunted, his hands jammed deep into his pockets, though tiny, impatient sparks popped faintly against his palms.*

*Uraraka took a slow breath, looking around at the lush greenery and the glowing Anemo Crystalflies drifting through the air.* "I know we’re technically lost, but... if you ask me, this woods feel surprisingly peaceful."

"I agree, Uraraka," *Momo said, her gaze sweeping over the vibrant foliage as she subtly adjusted her gauntlets.* "The atmosphere is calm, but we shouldn't let our guard down until we identify our location."

*Midoriya nodded absently, already scribbling mental notes on the strange, wind-infused flora around them. But before he could speak, Aizawa held up a single hand, signaling an immediate halt.
The class froze. Up ahead, through a break in the trees, something stood waiting in the distance.*
typesense:latest.name: MHA x Genshin Impact
typesense:latest.title: ★ 1-A Got dragged into another world!? 🌍🌟
